## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Wheeling, United States. It starts at 345 Zoo Circle.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Book your Oglebay Good Zoo general admission tickets in advance and prepare for an exciting, educational day at West Virginia's only AZA-accredited zoo.
>
> Whether it's strolling the shaded, forested grounds and experiencing the animal habitats or enjoying a narrated tour on the zoo train, Oglebay Good Zoo guests will have the opportunity to learn about the wide array of species cared for at Oglebay.
>
> From tamarins to armadillos, cheetahs, bald eagles, and the humble donkey, your admission tickets grant you self-guided access of this wonderful animal park.
>
> \**Oglebay Good Zoo prices vary**, but you can trust that any discounts on admission will be available on this page.

## Where this page comes from
